meanings.note: Pinyin: yī. Changes tone to yí before 4th tone (一个 yí gè) and yì before 1st/2nd/3rd tones (一杯 yì bēi).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí xià. Placed after an action verb to make a request or suggestion sound casual and brief (看一下, 等一下).

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 我觉得我跟他离得好远，他跟我说一句话，我脑子就直接充血，使劲转不停。
examples.trans: Yet he feels so far away — when he speaks one sentence to me, the blood rushes to my head and my mind spins!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Colloquial adverb yíkuàir ('together').

examples.text: 一会儿咱们一块儿去吃饭吧。
examples.trans: Let us go eat together in a moment.

examples.text: 我希望也能跟你们一块儿做节目。
examples.trans: I hope to produce shows together with you too.

examples.text: 一大早来打扰你很不好意思，我走了。
examples.trans: Sorry to disturb you so early in the morning — I'll head out now.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì diǎnr. Erhua quantifier/adverb 一 ('one') + 点儿 ('little bit'); used after adjectives (低一点儿 'a tiny bit flat') or before 也不/都没 ('not at all').

examples.text: 那根高音钢丝听起来还稍微低一点儿，再调一下吧。
examples.trans: That treble steel string still sounds a tiny bit flat; let's tune it a touch more.

examples.text: 水性的花园油漆气味很小，走廊里一点儿也不呛人。
examples.trans: Water-based garden paint has very little odour and isn't pungent in the hallway at all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qī. Cardinal number 7; combines with 月 for July and 点 for seven o'clock.

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
examples.trans: At seven thirty, eight hungry guests are coming downstairs!

meanings.note: Pinyin: sān shí. Cardinal number thirty ('three tens'); pairs directly with measure words like 三十年 ('thirty years').

examples.text: 这棵老树在院子里长了三十年。
examples.trans: This old tree has grown in the courtyard for thirty years.

examples.text: 从客栈走到地铁站只要三十分钟。
examples.trans: Walking from the inn to the metro station takes only thirty minutes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng. Used both as a directional verb/complement ('up, onto') and location word ('on top of').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià qù. Compound directional complement 下 ('down') + 去 ('away from speaker'), often attached after action verbs like 按下去 ('press down').

examples.text: 把开关轻轻按下去，走廊的灯就亮了。
examples.trans: Press the switch gently down and the hallway light comes on.

examples.text: 如果雨一直下下去，我们就在屋里喝茶。
examples.trans: If the rain keeps coming down, we will drink tea indoors.

meanings.note: Friendly farewell xiàcì jiàn.

examples.text: 今天聊得很开心，下次见！
examples.trans: Great chatting today, see you next time!

examples.text: 我们下次见！
examples.trans: See you next time!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù. Standard negation for present/future/habitual verbs and adjectives; shifts to bú before a 4th tone (不是 bú shì).

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

meanings.note: Pinyin: liǎng. Used instead of 二 when counting things with a measure word (两个, 两把, 两间).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.en: tightly sealed; packed or wrapped without any gap
meanings.note: Pinyin: yán yán shí shí. Reduplicated AABB form of 严实 (yán shi), intensifying how securely something is closed or covered.

examples.text: 你不仅过塑封得严严实实，还用粗字写着蜂蜜和甜橙皮？！
examples.trans: Did you even laminate it waterproof-tight AND write honey and orange zest in bold letters?!

examples.text: 小美把刚出炉的杏仁蛋糕用亚麻布盖得严严实实。
examples.trans: Mei covered the freshly baked almond cakes tightly with a linen cloth.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gè. Most common Mandarin measure word (量词), placed between a number/demonstrative and a noun (一个人, 这个).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wèi. Introduces a beneficiary or purpose before the verb (为您准备 'prepare for you').

examples.text: 请别担心！我们特意为您准备好了安静的三楼阁楼书房。
examples.trans: Please do not worry! We specially prepared our quiet third-floor attic study for you.

examples.text: 等周经理听说他为分贝慌了一整夜，表情一定精彩！
examples.trans: Wait until Manager Zhou hears he panicked all night over decibels!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jǔ qǐ. Resultative verb compound 举 ('lift/hold aloft') + 起 ('upward'), used for raising a teacup in a toast or lifting one's hand.

examples.text: 大家都举起热茶杯，一起敬重获新生的九号房。
examples.trans: Everyone raised their warm teacups in a toast to the newly restored Room Nine.

examples.text: 小美举起手里的木勺，像乐队指挥一样轻轻敲了两下。
examples.trans: Mei lifted the wooden spoon in her hand and tapped twice like an orchestra conductor.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǔ. Cardinal number 9.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

examples.text: 九分钟！牛奶、鸡蛋和苹果都买来了！
examples.trans: Nine minutes! The milk, eggs, and apples are all here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yě. Always stands directly before the verb or adjective, never at the end of a clause.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: Pinyin: èr shí bā. Cardinal number 二十 ('twenty') + 八 ('eight'); becomes ordinal with 第 (第二十八 'twenty-eighth').

examples.text: 这首曲子的第二十八小节非常温柔。
examples.trans: The twenty-eighth bar of this piece is very gentle.

examples.text: 二月通常只有二十八天。
examples.trans: February usually has only twenty-eight days.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǔ yuè. Fifth month of the year ('month five').

examples.text: 五月的成都院子里到处都是花香。
examples.trans: In May, courtyards in Chengdu are filled with the scent of flowers everywhere.

examples.text: 这张旧照片是五月的一个晴天拍的。
examples.trans: This old photo was taken on a sunny day in May.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liàng. Describes bright light or a surface polished clean (擦亮 'polish bright').

examples.text: 隔壁的小洗手间呢？灯亮吗？
examples.trans: What about the small bathroom next door? Does the light work?

examples.text: 火苗亮了——稳稳的蓝火，正合适。
examples.trans: The flame is lit—steady blue fire, right as it should be.

今后.gloss: from now on; in the future

meanings.en: from this point onward; in future years
meanings.note: Pinyin: jīn hòu. Temporal noun built from 今 (today, now) and 后 (afterward), often opening a forward-looking clause.

examples.text: 结实、平整，今后三十个五月都可以安稳摆一号桌了。
examples.trans: Solid, level, and ready to hold table one steady for the next thirty Mays.

examples.text: 经历这次大风以后，周经理决定今后每次活动都多抄一份备份。
examples.trans: After this gust of wind, Zhou decided that from now on he will always copy a backup for every event.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wèi. Polite counterpart of 个 when counting guests, customers, or teachers (一位客人, 这位老师).

examples.text: 太谢谢你们两位了。
examples.trans: Thank you both so very much.

examples.text: 七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
examples.trans: At seven thirty, eight hungry guests are coming downstairs!

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǐ. Everyday singular 'you' among colleagues, friends, and peers; use 您 for polite respect.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiān. Placed before the verb to sequence actions: 先…再… ('first…, then…').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: quán. Emphasizes entirety before 都 or a verb (全都 'every single one').

examples.text: 怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
examples.trans: No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!

examples.text: 四张桌子，八把椅子，全摆好了！
examples.trans: Four tables, eight chairs—everything is set in place!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. Marks a next step in sequence (先提再推) or a future repetition (再见 'see you again').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǔn bèi. Used for preparing rooms, breakfast, or plans.

examples.text: 大家早上好！欢迎你，小晴。都准备好了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning, everyone! Welcome, Qing. Is everything ready?

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāng. Placed right before a verb to show the action happened moments ago.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

examples.text: 一到七号钥匙全拿走了，八号房刚刷了油漆。
examples.trans: Every key from one to seven is taken, and room eight just got fresh paint.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qián. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个前面 ('a front side').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qián tái. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个前台 ('a front desk').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 您刚才忘在楼下前台汤碗旁边了。
examples.trans: You left it downstairs beside the soup bowl at the front desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: běi. Direction noun; combines with 往 ('toward') as 往北 ('northward') or 边 as 北边 ('the north side').

examples.text: 如果你们有一天重开九号房，从老树往北数三块平石板！
examples.trans: If you ever reopen Room Nine, count three flat flagstones north from the old tree!

examples.text: 阳光房朝南的窗户最亮，北边的木墙正好放书架。
examples.trans: The south-facing windows of the sunroom are brightest, while the north wooden wall is ideal for bookshelves.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qù. Movement away from the speaker, as main verb (去车站) or directional complement (上去).

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòu. Marks an action repeating, or pairs two qualities in 又A又B ('both A and B').

examples.text: 真的可以吗？看着又好看又暖和！
examples.trans: Is that really alright? It looks both lovely and warm!

examples.text: 又是深蓝色行李箱！这是宋老师的吗？
examples.trans: Another dark-blue suitcase! Is this Teacher Song's?

meanings.en: to fret; to feel worried or troubled over a problem
meanings.note: Pinyin: fā chóu. Often paired with 为 (wèi) in 为……发愁 ('to worry about something').

examples.text: 两星期前星期一一大早刚开门那会儿，我还为一只拿错的蓝皮箱发愁呢。
examples.trans: When Monday morning started two weeks ago, I was worrying over a single swapped blue suitcase.

examples.text: 有老陈在工具间帮忙，周经理再也不用为大风吹跑名牌发愁了。
examples.trans: With Chen helping out from the workshop, Zhou no longer had to fret over wind blowing away place cards.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ. Read zhǐ as the adverb 'only' before verbs, and zhī as a measure word for cups, boxes, and small animals.

examples.text: 而且他今晚八点到这里——只剩四十分钟了！
examples.trans: And he arrives here at eight o'clock this evening—in forty minutes!

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

meanings.note: Pinyin: ké yǐ. Polite modal verb for asking or granting permission (可以吗？ 'Is that alright?').

examples.text: 真的可以吗？看着又好看又暖和！
examples.trans: Is that really alright? It looks both lovely and warm!

examples.text: 阁楼书房？我可以先上去看看吗？
examples.trans: An attic study? May I go up and see it first?

meanings.note: Pinyin: hào. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个号码 ('a number').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Locative noun hòu ('afterwards; behind').

examples.text: 您看完修改后的方案觉得如何？
examples.trans: What do you think after reading the revised plan?

examples.text: 许久后我才明白他的良苦用心。
examples.trans: Only much later did I understand his good intentions.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ma. Placed at the end of any statement to turn it into a neutral yes/no question.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: ba. At the end of a sentence, softens commands into friendly suggestions ('let's…') or asks for confirmation.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ya. Gentle exclamation of surprise or realization.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 呀，这就是星期一火车上那只双胞胎箱子吗？
examples.trans: Oh, is this that twin suitcase from Monday's train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: ne. After a noun, asks 'what about X?' (你呢？); at the end of a statement, highlights an ongoing situation.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé. Joins nouns or pronouns ('A and B'), NEVER two whole clauses; also means 'with' (和你一样).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.en: we; us; our (inclusive of both the speaker and the listener)
meanings.note: Pinyin: zánmen. Unlike 我们 (which can exclude the listener), 咱们 specifically includes the person spoken to, creating a warm, collegial, or colloquial tone. Directly modifies nouns without 的 in set expressions like 咱们这行.

examples.text: 干咱们这行，谁不想跟他学习？
examples.trans: In our line of work, who wouldn't want to learn from him?

examples.text: 淳于总已经批准咱们的方案了。
examples.trans: Director Chun Yu has already approved our proposal.

meanings.note: Pinyin: la. Colloquial fusion of 了 + 啊 adding cheerful energy at the end of a sentence.

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 你们守着，我出门啦！
examples.trans: Hold the fort—I am heading out the door!

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí. As a verb, 'return' (回家, 回来); as a measure word, 'occasion/time' (这回 'this time').

examples.text: 那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
examples.trans: Why did that person run off without taking his own suitcase back?

examples.text: 他没要回那个装木头小火车的箱子吗？
examples.trans: Did he not ask back for that case with the wooden train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Neutral-tone structural particle turning a descriptive phrase into an adverb before a verb (轻轻地放 'set down gently'); distinct from noun di4 ('ground').

examples.text: 小晴整整齐齐地把茶杯排在木架上。
examples.trans: Qing arranged the teacups neatly on the wooden shelf.

examples.text: 老陈仔细地检查了每一根新电线。
examples.trans: Chen carefully checked every single new wire.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì tú. Combines 地 ('earth/land') + 图 ('chart/drawing'); measure word: 张 (zhāng) or 幅 (fú).

examples.text: 那时我是个年轻的制图员，你们阳光房的热茶救了我淋湿的地图。
examples.trans: Back then I was a young mapmaker, and your sunroom tea saved my rain-soaked maps.

examples.text: 小晴在手绘地图上用红笔标出了过桥以后的绿药店。
examples.trans: On the hand-drawn map, Qing marked the green pharmacy past the bridge in red pen.

块.gloss: measure word for pieces and yuan

meanings.en: measure word for pieces and yuan
meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài. Counts chunks/pieces (一块蛋糕 'a piece of cake') and spoken yuan of money (五块钱 'five yuan').

examples.text: 钱箱里拿五十块，记得要收据！
examples.trans: Here is fifty yuan from the cash box; remember to get a receipt!

examples.text: 在这儿！一共三十八块，找回十二块零钱。
examples.trans: Right here! Thirty-eight yuan in total, with twelve yuan back in change.

meanings.en: sound; voice; measure word for sounds
meanings.note: Pinyin: shēng. Counts cries, knocks, or chimes (一声 'one sound').

examples.text: 来不及了！他说了声谢谢就挂断了！
examples.trans: Too late! He said thank you and hung up!

examples.text: 非常安静！不过刚才你听到奇怪的金属敲击声了吗？
examples.trans: Very quiet! Though did you hear a strange metallic knocking sound just now?

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个夏天 ('a summer').

examples.text: 房东律师寄来的？奇怪——我们房租一直交到明年夏天了。
examples.trans: Sent by the landlord's lawyer? Strange—our rent is paid right through next summer.

examples.text: 夏天坐在大树底下乘凉最舒服。
examples.trans: Sitting in the shade beneath the big tree in summer is bliss.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duō. Means 'many' as an adjective, 'how…?' before adjectives (多大), or 'more than' after round numbers (三十多).

examples.text: 声音轻，很有礼貌，大概三十多岁，有点紧张。
examples.trans: Soft-spoken, very polite, around thirty-something, and a bit nervous.

examples.text: 说实话，我比以前灰色办公室喜欢这儿多了。
examples.trans: Honestly, I like this place far better than my old grey office.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yè kōng. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn), e.g. 一片夜空 ('an expanse of night sky').

examples.text: 抬头看夜空下那些金色灯笼——真宁静啊！
examples.trans: Look up at those golden lanterns against the night sky—how peaceful!

examples.text: 雨停以后，夜空格外干净。
examples.trans: After the rain stopped, the night sky looked remarkably clear.

related.gloss: an expanse of night sky (measure word 片)

meanings.note: Warm erhua form of 大伙.

examples.text: 这件事连累了您，大伙儿心里都过意不去。
examples.trans: Dragging you into this left everybody feeling bad.

examples.text: 天色不早了，大伙儿赶紧收拾东西回家吧。
examples.trans: It is getting late—everybody pack up and head home.

meanings.note: Prefix/noun tóu ('first, initial; head').

examples.text: 开篇的头一句就是道可道。
examples.trans: The very first line at the opening is Dao Ke Dao.

examples.text: 这是我头一回进大型演播室。
examples.trans: This is my very first time inside a major TV studio.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo. Main adjective 'good'; as a result complement after a verb, means 'ready/completed properly' (修好, 准备好).

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

meanings.en: lucky sign; auspicious token at the start of an event
meanings.note: Pinyin: háo cǎi tóu. Warm colloquial phrase often used with 讨个 ('seek a...') during celebrations or openings.

examples.text: 一点儿也不晃！老陈，拿你的木头手柄轻敲一下讨个好彩头。
examples.trans: Not a wobble anywhere! Tap it once with your wooden handle for good luck, Chen.

examples.text: 门前灯笼亮起来的那一刻，街坊们都鼓掌说是个好彩头。
examples.trans: The moment the courtyard lanterns lit up, neighbors applauded and called it a lucky sign.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo kàn. Literally 'good to look at'.

examples.text: 真的可以吗？看着又好看又暖和！
examples.trans: Is that really alright? It looks both lovely and warm!

examples.text: 院子里新挂的纸灯笼真好看。
examples.trans: The paper lanterns newly hung in the courtyard look lovely.

meanings.en: rock-steady without wobbling; calm and secure
meanings.note: Pinyin: ān wěn. Describes both sturdy furniture and peaceful sleep or mood.

examples.text: 结实、平整，今后三十个五月都可以安稳摆一号桌了。
examples.trans: Solid, level, and ready to hold table one steady for the next thirty Mays.

examples.text: 加上雪松木隔条之后，两排灯笼在晚风里挂得特别安稳。
examples.trans: Once the cedar spacer bars were added, both rows of lanterns hung wonderfully steady in the evening breeze.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo xīn. Literally 'small heart'—pay close attention.

examples.text: 小心，周经理，壶嘴很宽！
examples.trans: Careful, Manager Zhou, the pitcher spout is wide!

examples.text: 拐弯小心点，别碰到墙！
examples.trans: Careful on the turn—do not bump the wall!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo qíng. Friendly name of Courtyard Inn's new receptionist.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo yuàn kè zhàn. Eight-room boutique courtyard inn on Wutong Lane in Chengdu.

examples.text: 欢迎来到小院客栈，小晴。明天不会无聊了。
examples.trans: Welcome to Courtyard Inn, Qing. Tomorrow will not be boring.

examples.text: 小院客栈，早上好！我是小晴。
examples.trans: Courtyard Inn, good morning! This is Qing speaking.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Highlights immediacy, exact location (就在这里), or smooth consequence ('then').

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

屋檐.gloss: eaves, roof (figurative in 在屋檐下低头)

meanings.en: eaves, roof (figurative in 在屋檐下低头)
meanings.note: Evokes the proverb 人在屋檐下，不得不低头.

examples.text: 雨水顺着古老庭院的屋檐一滴一滴落下来。
examples.trans: Raindrops dripped one by one from the eaves of the old courtyard.

examples.text: 为了保住心血之作，大家暂时在别人的屋檐下忍耐。
examples.trans: To save their labor of love, everyone endured under a rival's roof for now.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wū lǐ. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 屋里空间 ('space inside the room').

examples.text: 从明天早上八点开始！屋里四张桌，树下三张桌！
examples.trans: Starting tomorrow morning at eight! Four tables indoors, three tables under the tree!

examples.text: 开了暖气，屋里一下子暖和起来了。
examples.trans: With the heat on, the inside of the room warmed right up.

related.gloss: space inside the room (measure word 间)

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块布 ('a piece of cloth').

examples.text: 周经理，给您干净布和冷水。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, here is a clean cloth and cold water for you.

examples.text: 请拿一块干净的布擦桌子。
examples.trans: Please take a clean cloth to wipe the table.

related.gloss: a piece of cloth (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: bāng. Everyday verb for helping someone (帮我一下 'give me a hand').

examples.text: 我来帮您。哎呀，里面装了石头吗？
examples.trans: Let me help you. Goodness, did you pack stones inside?

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gān jìng. Note first tone gān ('dry/clean'), never fourth tone.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gān shuǎng. Combines 干 (gān, 'dry') + 爽 ('crisp/refreshing'): pleasantly dry without a trace of dampness.

examples.text: 幸好搬得及时，四扇木窗板都干爽得很。
examples.trans: Luckily we moved them in time; all four wooden shutters are bone-dry.

examples.text: 秋天的空气干爽舒适，最适合晒被子。
examples.trans: Autumn air is crisp and dry, ideal for airing quilts.

meanings.note: Pinyin: píng. Used as a stative adjective ('flat/level') or resultative complement after verbs (收平 'fold flat', 铺平 'smooth flat').

examples.text: 把折叠椅收平以后，就能靠墙放好了。
examples.trans: Once you fold the chair flat, you can lean it neatly against the wall.

examples.text: 院子中间的石板路铺得很平。
examples.trans: The flagstone path in the middle of the courtyard is laid very flat.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nián. Time classifier taking no 个 directly after numbers (六年 'six years', 今年 'this year').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

meanings.en: open the door; open for business
meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi mén. Means both opening a physical door and opening a shop for the day.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎng shàng. Directional phrase 往 ('toward') + 上 ('up'), placed directly before action verbs (往上抬 'lift upward').

examples.text: 先把窗板轻轻往上抬一点，再往外拉。
examples.trans: Lift the shutter slightly upward first, then pull outward.

examples.text: 到了中间部分，圆舞曲的旋律一步步往上升。
examples.trans: In the middle section, the waltz melody climbs upward step by step.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Read de after a verb to introduce how it goes (走得快 'walk fast'); read děi before a verb to mean 'must'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nín. Respectful singular 'you' used with elders, teachers, and guests (您好！).

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间房 ('a room').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shǒu zhǐ. Compound 手 ('hand') + 指 ('digit/point'). Measure word: 根 (gēn), e.g. 两根手指 ('two fingers').

examples.text: 宋老师的手指轻轻落在黑白琴键上。
examples.trans: Teacher Song's fingers landed gently on the black and white piano keys.

examples.text: 墙上的油漆还没干，千万别用手指碰。
examples.trans: The paint on the wall isn't dry yet—don't touch it with your fingers.

examples.text: 手柄旋转三百六以上，技术犯规。
examples.trans: Spinning the handle past three hundred sixty degrees is a technical foul.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.en: measure word for handled objects; disposal marker
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ. Counts items with handles or backs (一把钥匙, 一把椅子); as a preposition, fronts a definite object before an action verb.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ná. Core verb for holding or fetching objects in the hand.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

examples.text: 火车站有人拿错了我的蓝色行李箱！
examples.trans: Someone at the train station took my blue suitcase by mistake!

related.gloss: handle with care (lift gently, set down gently)

meanings.note: Pinyin: guà. Used for hanging keys, coats, lanterns, or hanging up a phone.

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

examples.text: 挂在书桌右边吧，那里光线好。
examples.trans: Hang it to the right of the desk, where the light is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ nán zhēn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个指南针 ('a compass'). Literally 'south-pointing needle'.

examples.text: 小晴手里拿着黄铜指南针，顺着梧桐巷往东走。
examples.trans: Holding the brass compass in hand, Qing walks east along Wutong Lane.

examples.text: 这个实心黄铜指南针埋在地下三十年，依然非常准。
examples.trans: Buried underground for thirty years, this solid brass compass is still remarkably accurate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huàn. Used for swapping suitcases, changing rooms, or replacing broken parts.

examples.text: 上周刚换了新灯泡，有干净肥皂和热水。
examples.trans: Put in a new bulb last week, with clean soap and plenty of hot water.

examples.text: 等等，换房间我们给他打多少折？
examples.trans: Wait—what discount do we offer him for changing rooms?

搭把手.gloss: lend a hand, pitch in briefly

meanings.en: lend a hand, pitch in briefly
meanings.note: Colloquial northern phrase for helping someone carry or do something.

examples.text: 这箱器材太沉了，快过来搭把手。
examples.trans: This crate of gear is heavy—come lend a hand.

examples.text: 看他忙不过来，同事主动上去搭把手。
examples.trans: Seeing him swamped, a colleague stepped up to lend a hand.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎi. Used for setting out plates, chairs, or flowers neatly (摆好).

examples.text: 四张桌子，八把椅子，全摆好了！
examples.trans: Four tables, eight chairs—everything is set in place!

examples.text: 桌子上摆好了四个蓝茶杯。
examples.trans: Four blue teacups are neatly set out on the table.

examples.text: 把新鲜的柠檬片放进去，红茶的味道会更清香。
examples.trans: Put the fresh lemon slices in and the black tea will smell even more fragrant.

examples.text: 木盒太小了，这本厚厚的相册恐怕没法放进去。
examples.trans: The wooden box is too small; I am afraid this thick photo album cannot fit inside.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiāo. Used for knocking on doors or pipes clanking.

examples.text: 听……街口钟楼开始敲十二下了！
examples.trans: Listen... the clock tower at the end of the street is starting to strike twelve!

examples.text: 十二下敲完了……大门外面街上空荡荡的。
examples.trans: Twelve chimes have finished... and the street outside the gate is completely empty.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěng. Combines with a measure word to mean 'the entire' (整条街 'the whole street', 整栋楼 'the whole building').

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 今晚半价，而且一整周早餐免费！
examples.trans: Half price tonight, plus free breakfast all week!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个星期 ('a week').

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 脑子转得快，小晴。志豪每星期都读城市建筑规定。
examples.trans: Quick thinking, Qing. Hao reads city building rules every single week.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī yī. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 上星期一 ('last Monday').

examples.text: 呀，这就是星期一火车上那只双胞胎箱子吗？
examples.trans: Oh, is this that twin suitcase from Monday's train?

examples.text: 您尽管看，宋老师。星期一下午大堂暗。
examples.trans: Go right ahead, Teacher Song. Monday afternoon the lobby was dim.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huǎng. As huǎng (3rd tone), means 'flash past / dazzle the eyes' (晃眼); as huàng (4th tone), means 'sway/shake'.

examples.text: 小晴，那准是磨砂玻璃灯罩晃了眼。
examples.trans: Must be the frosted glass lampshade playing a trick on your eyes, Qing.

examples.text: 正午的阳光照在水面上，亮得有点晃眼。
examples.trans: The midday sunlight shining on the water is bright enough to dazzle the eyes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nuán nuǎn. Affectionate reduplicated verb (暖暖身子 'warm yourself up').

examples.text: 早上好！在楼上就闻到暖暖的肉桂香味了！
examples.trans: Good morning! All the way upstairs I smelled warm cinnamon!

examples.text: 先喝碗热汤暖暖手和胃吧。
examples.trans: Drink a bowl of hot soup first to warm up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǒu. Expresses both possession ('I have') and existence ('there is'); ALWAYS negated with 没 (没有), never 不.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

meanings.note: Pinyin: péng you. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个朋友 ('a friend').

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 今天有两位老朋友从外地来看我。
examples.trans: Two old friends are visiting me from out of town today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù tou. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块木头 ('a piece of wood').

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

examples.text: 怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
examples.trans: No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!

related.gloss: a piece of wood (measure word 块)

meanings.en: flat board, plank, or solid slab of wood or stone
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎn zi. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块木板子 (a wooden plank).

examples.text: 小心手指头，老板——北边沿先落下去，再让整块板子稳稳贴平。
examples.trans: Watch your fingers, boss—lower the north edge first, then let the whole slab settle flat.

examples.text: 老陈挑了一块干透的雪松板子，准备刻上周年纪念日期。
examples.trans: Chen picked out a well-seasoned cedar board to carve the anniversary date.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhī. Classifier for slender plant stems, flower sprays, or herb sprigs (两小枝香草 'two small sprigs of herbs', 一枝玫瑰 'a rose stem').

examples.text: 小美让志鹏用细棉绳绑好两小枝刚摘下来的新鲜香草。
examples.trans: Mei had Peng tie two small sprigs of freshly picked herbs together with fine cotton string.

examples.text: 小晴在玻璃花瓶里插了一枝嫩绿的枝叶，桌子一下子亮了起来。
examples.trans: Qing placed a sprig of fresh green foliage in the glass vase, brightening the table right up.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shù. Measure word (量词): 棵, e.g. 一棵树 ('a tree').

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

examples.text: 只有院子里的老树和雨声。
examples.trans: Only the old tree in the courtyard and the sound of rain.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuō. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张桌子 ('a table').

examples.text: 等等——小美这会儿正要把蛋糕端到他们那桌去。
examples.trans: Wait—Mei is taking the cake out to their table right now.

examples.text: 从明天早上八点开始！屋里四张桌，树下三张桌！
examples.trans: Starting tomorrow morning at eight! Four tables indoors, three tables under the tree!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lóu shàng. Measure word (量词): 层 (céng), e.g. 楼上房间 ('an upstairs floor').

examples.text: 老陈早！楼上洗澡水真的已经凉了吗？
examples.trans: Morning, Chen! Is the shower water upstairs really cold already?

examples.text: 早上好！在楼上就闻到暖暖的肉桂香味了！
examples.trans: Good morning! All the way upstairs I smelled warm cinnamon!

meanings.note: Pinyin: méi. Short form of 没有; negates 有 and past/completed actions (没锁 'isn't locked / didn't lock').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé shā. Measure word (量词): 层 (céng, 'a layer of') or 把 (bǎ, 'a handful of'). Clean, dry sand washed from a riverbed.

examples.text: 石板下面的方坑里铺着一层干净干燥的河沙。
examples.trans: Spread inside the square pit under the flagstone is a layer of clean, dry river sand.

examples.text: 细细的河沙能排水透气，让包裹保持干爽。
examples.trans: Fine river sand drains water and breathes well, keeping the parcel dry.

注意.gloss: pay attention to, watch out for

meanings.en: pay attention to, watch out for
meanings.note: Verb zhùyì.

examples.text: 要注意身体啊！
examples.trans: Take care of your health!

examples.text: 请注意时间。
examples.trans: Please watch the time.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huá. Describes wet stone steps being slippery or an object sliding down.

examples.text: 周经理！这回您眼镜从鼻子上滑下来是因为太高兴啦！
examples.trans: Manager Zhou! This time your glasses slid off your nose from sheer joy!

examples.text: 听我把箱子斜过来——里面有金属东西滑了一下。
examples.trans: Listen as I tilt the box—something metal slid inside.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mǎn. Describes a full cup or a fully booked hotel.

examples.text: 外面下着大雨，街上酒店全满了！我们怎么办？
examples.trans: It is pouring rain outside and every hotel on the street is full! What do we do?

examples.text: 啊……下这么大的雨，车站附近酒店全满了。
examples.trans: Ah... in rain this heavy, every hotel near the station was full.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dēng long. Measure word (量词): 盏 (zhǎn), e.g. 一盏灯笼 ('a lantern').

examples.text: 老陈，你在为中午挂纸灯笼吗？
examples.trans: Chen, are you hanging those paper lanterns for noon?

examples.text: 抬头看夜空下那些金色灯笼——真宁静啊！
examples.trans: Look up at those golden lanterns against the night sky—how peaceful!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàn zài. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 现在这时候 ('this moment right now').

examples.text: 现在他的箱子还安全锁着呢。
examples.trans: For now, his suitcase stays safely locked up.

examples.text: 太好了！现在我想吃一顿丰盛的早餐。
examples.trans: Wonderful! Now I would like to eat a big breakfast.

related.gloss: this moment right now (measure word 个)

meanings.note: Pinyin: qín. Measure word (量词): 架 (jià), e.g. 一架琴 ('a piano').

examples.text: 每次弹完琴，他都问为什么下雨天钢琴声音更暖。
examples.trans: Whenever I finished playing, he asked why the piano sounded warmer on rainy days.

examples.text: 她从小就喜欢每天练琴。
examples.trans: She has loved practicing the piano every day since childhood.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liú. Used for leaving a note/keepsake, saving food, or staying on (留下来).

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 为什么把鞋和木头小火车留到星期五呢？
examples.trans: Why leave the shoes and little wooden train here until Friday?

examples.text: 留在这里。
examples.trans: Stay here.

examples.text: 留在家里。
examples.trans: Stay at home.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: pí. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张皮 ('a piece of leather').

examples.text: 等等——柜台上这本棕色小皮笔记本是谁的？
examples.trans: Wait—whose small brown leather notebook is this on the counter?

examples.text: 啊，我的皮笔记本！谢谢！我正到处找呢。
examples.trans: Oh, my leather notebook! Thank you! I was looking everywhere for it.

related.gloss: a piece of leather (measure word 张)

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

眼眶.gloss: eye socket; rim of the eye

meanings.en: eye socket; rim of the eye
meanings.note: Pinyin: yǎn kuàng. Combines 眼 ('eye') + 眶 ('frame/socket of the eye'), frequently used in descriptions of emotion (眼眶湿润 'eyes brimming with tears').

examples.text: 听见窗里传出的十六个小节，老先生眼眶里全是泪水。
examples.trans: Hearing the sixteen bars drifting through the window, the older gentleman's eyes filled with tears.

examples.text: 周经理看着那枚蓝色的保护印章，眼眶也一下子红了。
examples.trans: Looking at that round blue heritage stamp, Manager Zhou's eyes grew misty too.

examples.text: 你瞧，窗台上的茉莉花今天早上全开了！
examples.trans: Look—the jasmine flowers on the windowsill all bloomed this morning!

examples.text: 快去瞧瞧，是谁把这包点心留在门廊的长椅上了？
examples.trans: Go take a quick look—who left this parcel of pastries on the porch bench?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuān cáo. Measure word: 个 (gè), e.g. 一个砖槽 ('a brick pocket').

examples.text: 周经理，准备好了跟老陈一块儿把青石板滑回砖槽上吗？
examples.trans: Ready to slide the flagstone back over the brick pocket with Chen, Manager Zhou?

examples.text: 石板底下的砖槽干爽又严实，放三十年都不会进水。
examples.trans: The brick pocket beneath the flagstone is bone-dry and snug, keeping water out for thirty years.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wén wěn. Reduplicated adverb describing steady hands or footing.

examples.text: 火苗亮了——稳稳的蓝火，正合适。
examples.trans: The flame is lit—steady blue fire, right as it should be.

examples.text: 她双手稳稳地端起盛满热茶的托盘。
examples.trans: With both hands she lifted the tray of hot tea steadily.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiāng. Bound/free root of 箱子 ('chest/box/suitcase'), used in 木箱 ('wooden chest') and 工具箱 ('toolbox').

examples.text: 阁楼角落里放着一只带铜锁的旧木箱。
examples.trans: In the corner of the attic sits an old wooden chest with a brass lock.

examples.text: 这箱新鲜黄柠檬是今天早上刚从果园运来的。
examples.trans: This crate of fresh yellow lemons was brought straight from the orchard this morning.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hóng. Describes the color red; note that 红茶 is what English calls 'black tea'.

examples.text: 告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
examples.trans: Tell them there is a red ribbon inside the top pocket of my case!

examples.text: 我的行李箱！快打开上面口袋……对，红丝带！
examples.trans: My suitcase! Let me open the top pocket... yes, the red ribbon!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē shi. Note first tone jiē + neutral shi ('solidly built').

examples.text: 有，结实的木床、干净书桌，风景全院最好。
examples.trans: Yes, a solid wooden bed, a clean desk, and the best view in the courtyard.

examples.text: 好位置。两把结实椅子，朝着花草，别朝着大堂窗户。
examples.trans: Good spot. Two sturdy chairs, facing the plants rather than the lobby window.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gěi. As main verb, 'give'; as preposition/complement, marks the recipient (给你 'for/to you', 递给我 'pass to me').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

meanings.note: Pinyin: luó pán. Measure word (量词): 面 (miàn) or 个 (gè). Joins 罗 ('net, to gather') + 盘 ('plate, tray').

examples.text: 抽屉深处藏着一面古董航海罗盘。
examples.trans: Hidden deep in the drawer is an antique nautical compass.

examples.text: 制图员教授当年就是用这面罗盘在山里测绘的。
examples.trans: The mapmaker professor used this very compass to survey in the mountains back in the day.

meanings.note: Pinyin: láo bǎn. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位老板 ('a boss / shop owner').

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

examples.text: 老板正在开锁呢！别挂电话，等我一秒钟。
examples.trans: The owner is unlocking it right now! Stay on the phone, wait one second.

related.gloss: a boss / shop owner (measure word 位)

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo chén. Affectionate respectful name for Courtyard Inn's handyman.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 谢谢老陈。里面的木头小火车看着很珍贵。
examples.trans: Thank you, Chen. The little wooden train inside looked very precious.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chá bēi. Measure word (量词): 只 (zhǐ), e.g. 一只茶杯 ('a teacup').

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

examples.text: 里面的茶杯呢？还完好吗？
examples.trans: And the teacup inside? Is it still intact?

meanings.note: Pinyin: luò. Used both literally for raindrops/leaves falling and musically for a phrase landing on a note (落在中央瑞音上).

examples.text: 到了第二十八小节，整段旋律稳稳落在了中央瑞音上。
examples.trans: In bar twenty-eight, the whole melody lands squarely on middle D.

examples.text: 几片金黄的梧桐叶轻轻落在院子的石桌上。
examples.trans: Several golden plane-tree leaves drifted gently down onto the courtyard stone table.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lán. Describes blue suitcases, doors, or teacups.

examples.text: 每个蓝杯子旁边放一张餐巾和一把小勺子。
examples.trans: Beside every blue cup, put one napkin and one small spoon.

examples.text: 储藏室里有两个软枕头和一块蓝地毯！
examples.trans: In the storeroom there are two soft pillows and a blue rug!

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēng là. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài) or 层 (céng). Joins 蜂 ('bee') + 蜡 ('wax').

examples.text: 信封的开口处滴着一圈红色的封印蜂蜡。
examples.trans: The opening of the envelope is dripped with a ring of red sealing beeswax.

examples.text: 老陈用一块天然蜂蜡仔细打磨着木雕。
examples.trans: Chen carefully polished the wood carving with a piece of natural beeswax.

meanings.en: to mount in a frame; framed (when modifying a picture or map)
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuāng kuàng. Combines 装 ('fit into') and 框 ('frame').

examples.text: 趁您眼眶还没又红起来，老板，搭把手帮我把装框地图挂屋里去。
examples.trans: Before you tear up again, boss, lend me a hand hanging that framed map inside.

examples.text: 老先生特意请人把这幅水彩地图装框，好让客栈大厅挂得长久。
examples.trans: The old gentleman had the watercolor map framed so it could hang in the inn lobby for years to come.

meanings.en: to wrap tightly around; bundle up in cloth or paper
meanings.note: Pinyin: guǒ. Often followed by 得严严实实 ('wrapped completely tight').

examples.text: 黄蜂蜡布裹得严严实实，干爽又平整地落在干净河沙上啦。
examples.trans: Wrapped tight in yellow waxed linen, resting dry and level on the clean river sand.

examples.text: 小晴用油纸把剩下几块杏仁蛋糕仔细裹好，留给晚归的客人。
examples.trans: Qing wrapped the remaining almond cake slices neatly in wax paper for guests returning late.

meanings.en: to ask for or invite (especially in 讨个好彩头 'do something for good luck')
meanings.note: Pinyin: tǎo. Distinct from 讨论 ('discuss'); very common in festive sayings.

examples.text: 一点儿也不晃！老陈，拿你的木头手柄轻敲一下讨个好彩头。
examples.trans: Not a wobble anywhere! Tap it once with your wooden handle for good luck, Chen.

examples.text: 文化节开幕前，周经理在大门挂上红绸带讨个喜庆彩头。
examples.trans: Before the festival opened, Zhou tied a red silk ribbon on the gate to bring good cheer.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ràng. Everyday causative/polite-offer verb (让我看看 'let me have a look').

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 宋老师，让我来给您倒新鲜橙汁！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, allow me to pour fresh orange juice for you!

meanings.en: should; ought to; be someone's turn
meanings.note: Pinyin: gāi. Short everyday form of 应该 ('should').

examples.text: 电线本来就该拉直了。正常保养，别多想。
examples.trans: The wire needed straightening anyway. Routine maintenance—don't read into it.

examples.text: 热茶和柠檬蛋糕！小晴，你该给紧张的弟弟开个学校。
examples.trans: Hot tea and lemon cake! Qing, you ought to open a school for nervous brothers.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiē. Used for taping envelopes, labels, or notices onto a surface.

examples.text: 看，把手上贴着一个白信封。
examples.trans: Look, there is a white envelope taped onto the handle.

examples.text: 对。我一慌，按了门铃，把星期五纸条贴在把手上。
examples.trans: Yes. In a panic I rang the bell and taped the Friday note onto the handle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qǐ lái. Marks standing up or beginning/evaluating an action.

examples.text: 摸摸铜管！已经热起来了！
examples.trans: Touch the copper pipe! It is warming up already!

examples.text: 快把那张纸折起来，塞进口袋里。
examples.trans: Fold up that sheet of paper right now and tuck it into your pocket.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chèn. Introduces a favorable moment before it passes (趁热吃 'eat while it's hot').

examples.text: 趁着阳光亮，我能再看看那张小纸牌吗？
examples.trans: While the sunlight is bright, may I look at that small paper tag again?

examples.text: 太好了……趁着等他们，我扫一眼这封房东来信。
examples.trans: Wonderful... while we wait, let me glance at this letter from the landlord.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gēn. As a verb, 'follow' (跟我来 'follow me'); as a preposition, 'with' (跟你一样 'same as yours').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qīng. Opposite of 重 ('heavy'); also describes gentle footsteps or soft voices.

examples.text: 声音轻，很有礼貌，大概三十多岁，有点紧张。
examples.trans: Soft-spoken, very polite, around thirty-something, and a bit nervous.

examples.text: 这个小皮箱很轻，我来拿吧。
examples.trans: This small suitcase is very light—let me carry it.

related.gloss: handle with care (lift gently, set down gently)

meanings.en: outer edge, rim, or margin of a flat object or slab
meanings.note: Pinyin: biān yán. Measure word: 条 (tiáo) or 道 (dào) when counting edges.

examples.text: 小心手指头，老板——北边沿先落下去，再让整块板子稳稳贴平。
examples.trans: Watch your fingers, boss—lower the north edge first, then let the whole slab settle flat.

examples.text: 老陈沿着铁盒边沿仔细缠了一圈白胶布，防潮效果特别好。
examples.trans: Chen carefully wrapped a strip of white cloth tape around the tin's rim to seal out dampness.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hái. Everyday adverb meaning 'still' (还在), 'not yet' (还没), or 'even more' after 比.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

examples.text: 宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, I am truly sorry; they have no news over there yet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tòu guò. Describes light or sound passing through an opening.

examples.text: 哎呀！透过窗户看见周经理了？我明明加倍用力微笑了！
examples.trans: Oh dear! You spotted Manager Zhou through the window? I smiled twice as wide!

examples.text: 早晨的阳光透过树叶照在白桌布上。
examples.trans: Morning sunshine filters through the leaves onto the white tablecloth.

meanings.note: Colloquial time phrase nàhuìr ('back then').

examples.text: 那会儿这段视频在网上传得特别火。
examples.trans: Back then, that video went viral online.

examples.text: 那会儿我还在传媒学院读书。
examples.trans: Back then I was still studying at Media College.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nàr. Spoken variant of 那里 ('there').

examples.text: 因为楼梯窄，而且周经理在那儿放了旧灯箱子。
examples.trans: Because the stairs are narrow, and Manager Zhou put old lamp boxes up there.

examples.text: 看车轮底下——铅笔写的你和我的名字还在那儿。
examples.trans: Look underneath the wheels—your name and mine in pencil are still right there.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lín jū. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位邻居 ('a neighbor').

examples.text: 超过八十年的小院建筑，只要一楼每天服务街坊邻居，禁止改成私人办公室。
examples.trans: Any courtyard building over eighty years old may not become private offices as long as the ground floor serves neighbours daily.

examples.text: 每天服务街坊邻居——就像对公众开放的早间咖啡馆？！
examples.trans: Serves neighbours daily—like a morning café open to the public?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōu. Summarizes everything BEFORE it and always stands directly before the verb/adjective (我们都喜欢).

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 里面 ('the inside').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

meanings.note: Pinyin: cuò. Describes mistakes or serves as a result complement meaning 'wrongly' (拿错 'take the wrong one').

examples.text: 火车站有人拿错了我的蓝色行李箱！
examples.trans: Someone at the train station took my blue suitcase by mistake!

examples.text: 哎呀，怎么拿错了！我戴眼镜看看行李牌。
examples.trans: Dear me, what a mix-up! Let me put on my glasses and check the luggage tag.

meanings.en: warm greeting; kind regards (also used as a verb: 'send greetings to')
meanings.note: Pinyin: wèn hòu. Measure word: 句 (jù) or 声 (shēng), e.g. 一句暖暖的问候 ('a warm greeting').

examples.text: 换上咱们七个朋友，给三十年后的夏天留一句暖暖的问候！
examples.trans: And in its place, seven friends leave behind a warm greeting for thirty summers ahead!

examples.text: 祝酒词卡片上写满了对梧桐巷老朋友们的亲切问候。
examples.trans: The toast card was filled with warm greetings for all the old friends on Wutong Lane.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiān. Counts rooms of all kinds: bedrooms, guest rooms, studies, kitchens (一间客房 'a guest room').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那间向阳的旧阁楼书房……快跟我来！
examples.trans: That sunny old attic study... follow me, quickly!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuàn zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个院子 ('a courtyard').

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.en: dark gray-blue stone paving slab; courtyard flagstone
meanings.note: Pinyin: qīng shí bǎn. Measure word: 块 (kuài), e.g. 第三块青石板 ('the third flagstone').

examples.text: 太精彩了！听听这二十八位邻里在院子青石板上响起的掌声吧——满院子都在鼓掌！
examples.trans: Bravo! Listen to the applause rising from all twenty-eight neighbors across the courtyard flagstones!

examples.text: 梧桐巷下过雨以后，湿润的青石板把红灯笼的影子映得亮晶晶的。
examples.trans: After rain on Wutong Lane, the damp flagstones reflect the red lanterns in a soft shimmer.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huáng. Describes yellow flowers, brass, or butter.

examples.text: 篮子里正躺着六个黄柠檬呢——厨房就等今天了！
examples.trans: Six yellow lemons are sitting in my basket right now—this kitchen was waiting for today!

examples.text: 秋天到了，院子里的树叶黄了。
examples.trans: Autumn has arrived, and the courtyard leaves have turned yellow.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huáng tóng. Literally 黄 ('yellow/golden') + 铜 ('copper/bronze'): copper-zinc brass alloy.

examples.text: 钢琴琴槌里面的细小轴销是用结实的黄铜做的。
examples.trans: The tiny hinge pins inside piano hammers are made of sturdy brass.

examples.text: 老陈把前台的黄铜小铃铛擦得金光发亮。
examples.trans: Chen polished the little brass bell on the front desk until it gleamed.
